name: HarvestYieldTracker
tagline: Every harvest load, field and bin in one Power Platform app – progress, dry tonnes, yield vs estimate and moisture.
description: A complete harvest operations module for grain farms and contractors: load tickets from field to chaser bin, truck and bin / dryer / buyer, moisture shrink to standard moisture, field progress and yield per hectare against the pre-harvest estimate, a drag-and-drop harvest board, crew and machine totals, destination fill and daily totals. One control for canvas and model-driven apps plus a Power Pages edition.
features: Demo mode with a fictional grain farm
Dry tonnes with moisture shrink per crop
Receival moisture limits and dryer routing
Bin capacity and crop segregation checks
Field progress and days to finish
Yield vs estimate per field and crop
Drag-and-drop harvest board with keyboard buttons
Truck cycle times and header / operator totals
Daily totals with target and DailyTotalsJson
Bulk dispatch / deliver / void / set destination
Phone bottom bar, cards and panels
